aspect: EXAMPLE - the BBC Africa Eye investigation
description: Reporter Kiki Mordi and three other undercover reporters spent nine months on the investigation and three months filming with hidden cameras at the University of Lagos and the University of Ghana. The footage showed lecturers harassing, propositioning and attempting to blackmail the reporters in closed-door meetings.
energy_note: Filmed, broadcast, and the lecturers suspended.

description: Mordi said one of her professors withheld her exam results for two semesters because she refused his advances, which led her to drop out and give up becoming a doctor. She tried to report it at the time and says it was clear nothing would be done.
energy_note: Two semesters withheld, and a different life.

aspect: The power is over the result, which is the point
description: The lecturer controls the mark, the resit, the project supervision and the reference. Refusal is not a single unpleasant conversation; it is a threat to the degree already paid for.
energy_note: He is not asking. He is holding your transcript.

description: The executive director of a Nigerian education nonprofit described the problem as pervasive in Nigeria and like an open secret. The African Feminist Initiative tied it to unequal power relations and abuse of power predominantly by male faculty.
energy_note: Everyone knows. That is the state of the problem.

aspect: The response was suspension and a bill
description: Both universities suspended the lecturers filmed, one implicated lecturer's church asked him to step down, and the Nigerian Senate reintroduced legislation criminalising sexual advances by lecturers toward students with mandatory jail time. One of those filmed called the documentary a hoax.
energy_note: Suspensions, a bill, and a denial.

aspect: What the documentary changed, and did not
description: Many women across Nigerian universities shared similar experiences after broadcast. The structural condition - one man controlling one woman's degree outcome with no independent marking - was not altered by any of it.
energy_note: A national conversation, and the same marking system.
